name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: SearchKeywords
label: Search Keywords
description: The value used to locate the drop-down list (e.g., 'country', '//select[@id='country']').

name: Operation
label: Operation
description: Specifies whether to select by name, index, or clear selection.

selectOptions.label: Clear All Options
selectOptions.description: Clears all selected values from the drop-down list.

selectOptions.label: Select Options by Name
selectOptions.description: Selects one or more options by their display text.

selectOptions.label: Select Options by Index
selectOptions.description: Selects one or more options by their index position.

name: OptionNames
label: Option Names
description: Comma-separated option names to select. Only first is used if not multi-select.

name: UseRegularExpressions
label: Use Regular Expressions
description: If true, matches option names using regular expressions.

name: OptionIndices
label: Option Indices
description: Comma-separated indices of options to select.

name: WaitForPageLoad
label: Wait for Page Load
description: If true, waits for the page to load after setting the dropdown value.

name: TimeoutForPageLoad
label: Timeout for Page Load
description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the page to load.

name: IfDialogAppears
label: Handle Dialog
description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after setting the dropdown value.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: The button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').
